quizGuardRationale: Direct exclusions are symmetric and nontransitive; identical titles already deduplicate. Meanings and fallback labels matter, not just title spelling. Baseline declarations remain unchanged from the established batch-19 result, including only its recorded 機械/道具 addition.
きっかけ protects opportunity and ordinary cause/reason labels while teaching starting-occasion emphasis; negative-cause せい is not thereby an unrestricted substitute for every opening.

ぎっしり protects actual tightly-packed, full, dense and crowding labels, including 込む's separate complete crowded/packed family. Squeezing, pressure and all senses of these comparisons are not made interchangeable.
基盤 protects foundation, basis and supporting-base labels, including 基準's documented basis sense. A study's criterion and an operating infrastructure need not be interchangeable in context.
客席 protects seat/seating, spectator stands and actual audience/person metonymy. Merely being a passenger does not make 乗客 a seating synonym.
客間 protects broad room and living/drawing-room labels, without equating every bedroom with a reception room.
ギャング protects 組's actual crime-family/syndicate sense. Neutral グループ, 団体 and other group nouns are not excluded by topic alone.
キャンパス protects 大学 because the actual Daijisen entry includes extended university use. Missing 構内 and キャンバス cards are explained in plain text, not invented as exclusion IDs.

休業 protects suspension, closure and actual holiday/day-off labels; closing a door and business suspension remain distinct in the prose. 休講 protects class suspension against cancellation and 休み, not student non-attendance merely by association.

休息/休養 protect direct rest/relaxation labels and ordinary relief, recuperation or recreation meanings. Recovery is an aim of 休養, not a claim that every instance of play restores health or every recovery comes from rest. No duration boundary is invented.
給与 protects actual pay, payment, provision, supply and giving labels. The source-selected provision sense and additional pay sense both remain visible; no rule requires a monthly payment cycle.
清い protects clean/pure/honest labels and unqualified English clear polysemy. A logical explanation's clarity is not automatically a natural 清い collocation.
強化 protects strengthening/intensification/improvement labels and the source's solidification wording. A generic English solidify does not establish that 強化 is a freezing verb.
境界 protects boundary, border and ordinary limit labels. 教会 is an unrelated homophone, not a same-meaning guard.
行事 protects event/occurrence and ceremony/ritual labels supported by the ordinary event and customary-ceremony uses. A festival is not automatically excluded merely because it is one kind of event.

恐縮 protects ordinary grateful/obliged, apology/request-preface and ashamed/embarrassed meanings, including courtesy expressions with secondary thanks or apology uses. This does not license every embarrassing situation as 恐縮.
教養 protects actual culture, education, learning and knowledge labels. Shared everyday expectations 常識 are not automatically personal cultivation.
行列 protects row/line/queue and lining-up labels, including English line polysemy on 線 and 筋. A drawn line is not thereby a Japanese procession, nor is every matrix a single row.
sourceAccessLimits: Nineteen new articles and one scoped reuse of 漁業 cover twenty rows. Reuse adds only sourced jlpt 2, not whole-article recertification.
Three new primary-form N2 pairs: 講/休講, 清/清い and 境/境界. Existing 漁/漁業 remains reciprocal.
Missing primary component cards 基, 盤, 養 and 縮 are not manufactured. All written primary-form characters remain in metadata. Rare alias components are retained in complete evidence.

All baseline identities, primary readings, titles, written-kanji arrays and easier sourced levels remain unchanged. Baseline exclusions preserve the exact established batch-19 result; no new baseline exclusion changes are made.

Bare Kotobank URLs for ギャング, キャンパス and きっかけ returned 404. The fetched 休息 page showed a World Encyclopedia article, not an inspected Seisenban lexical body. Neither is misreported as definition verification.
The fetched Weblio gang section was an English-word article in 実用日本語表現辞典, not a Japanese ギャング definition. Its neutral English friendship-group sense is not transferred to the card.
Complete families retain historical, specialist and unselected readings/senses. Additional senses are not independent official N2 assignments; the community list is not an official syllabus.

Inspection receipts record actual author access, not independent reviewer verification. Original teaching examples are not corpus quotations. No measured frequency, native-speaker certification or executed app draw is claimed.
Constituent meanings and on-first mixed-reading categories follow repository conventions; mnemonic associations are not historical etymology.

恐縮/恩.observation: Feeling obliged or grateful overlaps the actual debt-of-gratitude/obligation meanings and title of 恩. Other gratitude exclusions do not imply this direct pair.

恐縮/申し訳.observation: Apologetic feeling overlaps the apology/excuse title and the apologizing formulas taught on 申し訳. The bare noun is not mechanically interchangeable with every expression of being sorry.

給与/納める.observation: Pay/provision overlaps paying fees or taxes and delivering/supplying goods. Sense 4 expressly applies to 納める; the 収める-only achievement sense is not transferred.

行事/機能.observation: The English titles share unqualified 'function'. The teaching now distinguishes an organized social event from capability or operation; the guard does not assert that the Japanese words are general synonyms.

休講/おやすみ.observation: Conservative direct protection for a class being off against the polite noun's day-off/absence use. This does not identify a class cancellation with every person's absence or with the good-night greeting.

きっかけ/合図.observation: The principal entry already includes 'cue'. The added general starting-cue comparison overlaps 合図's actual signal/cue meaning, without claiming that every trigger is deliberate or adding specialist theater history.

clarifications.observation: Add positive teaching for being abashed/humbled by praise or kindness and ashamed of an error, plus an original praise example with kana and translation.

optionalNotAdopted.observation: The actual entries and titles distinguish a reception room from the activity of receiving visitors. A common substring alone does not establish title ambiguity; room compounds 応接間 and 応接室 are not the bare activity noun.

correctionEvidence.preservation: All original rows, selected/additional senses, complete principal families, component records, 178 comparison families, ten original inspections, quiz declarations and rationale remain unchanged. Six complete new comparison families and this correction record are appended. The seven-family correction extraction also rechecked the already present 1612680. All six content changes are new batch-20 articles; baseline identities, readings, titles, kanji arrays, levels and exclusions and the four original related content edits are untouched.
sourceLimits: Original declarations and receipts describe the authored snapshot and are not silently backdated.
Dictionary meanings and ordinary English title overlap justify the listed direct guards, not unrestricted Japanese substitution. Guards are symmetric, not transitive.
No executed app draw, measured frequency, exhaustive corpus correctness or native-speaker certification is claimed.
Absence of a component card is not independent JLPT-level evidence. The completed kanji cohort is the selected community list, not an official exhaustive modern syllabus.
